name: OrganicLea Community Growing
short_description: Epping Forest edge organic growing co-op.
description: OrganicLea is a workers co-operative growing organic fruit and vegetables on the edge of Epping Forest. Volunteers can join harvest and growing sessions and take home fresh produce.

name: Walthamstow Wetlands Elderberries
short_description: Elder and rosehips at the reservoir margins.
description: The scrubby margins of Walthamstow Wetlands nature reserve are rich in elder bushes and rosehips, offering a fine autumn harvest.
